localfn.script:
//@version=6
indicator("probe")
int hr = hour(time, "UTC")
g = hr % 7 == 0 ? na : close
r = hr % 11 < 3 ? na : close
sp = hr % 13 == 0 ? close : na
q = math.round(close / 50)
qg = hr % 5 == 0 ? na : q
f(float src, bool go) =>
    float s = na
    float h = na
    float m = na
    float c = na
    float w = na
    if go
        s := ta.sma(src, 10)
        h := ta.highest(src, 10)
        m := ta.median(src, 9)
        c := ta.cog(src, 8)
        w := ta.wma(src, 10)
    [s, h, m, c, w]
[s1, h1, m1, c1, w1] = f(close, hr % 2 == 0)
[s2, h2, m2, c2, w2] = f(open, hr % 4 != 1)
plot(s1, "f1 sma")
plot(h1, "f1 highest")
plot(m1, "f1 median")
plot(c1, "f1 cog")
plot(w1, "f1 wma")
plot(s2, "f2 sma")
plot(h2, "f2 highest")
plot(m2, "f2 median")
plot(c2, "f2 cog")
plot(w2, "f2 wma")
float lastBar = na
if barstate.islast
    lastBar := ta.sma(close, 20) + ta.highest(close, 20) + ta.median(close, 20) + ta.percentrank(close, 20)
plot(lastBar, "islast")
